description_en: Performs a manual primary/secondary switchover for an edge cluster
name: FailoverDBClusterZonal

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node to be switched to the primary node. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically elects a node. You can call the DescribeDBClusters operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 将要切换为主节点的节点 ID，如果不填，则系统自动选举。您可以通过接口 DescribeDBClusters 查询节点 ID 等信息
parameters.name: target_db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to switch back to the original primary zone after a failover. Valid values:

true: Switch back to the original primary zone.
false: Do not switch back to the original primary zone
parameters.help_zh:
是否是故障切换后的回切至原主可用区，取值范围如下：

true：是。
false：不是
parameters.name: roll_back_for_disaster

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the switchover is a primary/secondary switchover within the primary zone. Valid values:

Primary: primary/secondary switchover within the primary zone.
Standby: switchover to the hot standby storage cluster.

Default value: Primary. This value indicates that the switchover is performed within the active zone
parameters.help_zh:
是否是主可用区内主备切换，取值如下：

Primary：主可用区内主备切换。
Standby：切换至存储热备集群
parameters.name: target_zone_type
